rules.sentence: Screen high-risk populations, such as young adults with painless, slow-growing masses in distal extremities, for epithelioid sarcoma.
Diagnosis is determined by tissue biopsy, while imaging studies are essential for assessing the extent of the primary tumor and identifying metastatic disease.
Complete surgical resection is curative in early-stage disease.
Radiation therapy may be used as an adjunct treatment and as a palliative measure.
Recently, treatment options have evolved with the development of targeted therapies, which aim to improve patient outcomes.
However, local recurrence and late distant metastases may occur, necessitating long-term surveillance.
